exclusions.capability_name: AgentScope app/ module (FastAPI multi-tenant service layer)
exclusions.reason: The FastAPI multi-tenant service layer is a deployment/infrastructure concern, not a core multi-agent framework capability. It includes APIs for workspace/session/chat management. Deferred to a future feature if multi-tenancy is required.
Python TypedDict and dataclass are language-level features, not AgentScope-specific capabilities. Equivalent functionality will use Rust struct/enum with Serde serialization.
TTS functionality is a voice-based extension not required for core multi-agent compatibility. Deferred as ADVANCED priority.
